app.name: Weight Surgeon
approval.question: The agent asks
backend.lead: Rust only: mistral.rs (NVIDIA, Apple Silicon, CPU), hipfire (AMD GPU), native (CPU, built in).
backend.mistralrs.missing: mistral.rs not found: install it from the wizard (step 04)
backend.native.note: CPU, pure Rust, built in, SafeTensors folder
backend.requantize.tip: auto: a working copy without an alias for its current weights is requantized (q8f16, alias ws-<copy>-<sha8>) before it is measured on hipfire; off: never on hipfire (native for an agent, refused on the command line).
backend.title: Inference backend
bench.heuristic: heuristic: screening without generation, never a final proof
bench.native: hipfire set aside: it serves a quantized cache and ignores modified weights, this benchmark runs on native
chat.busy: The agent is working: pause or stop first
chat.keys: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
chat.list.empty.hint: Start a session in the center, it will show up here
checkpoints.none.hint: surgeon_checkpoint and surgeon_sweep freeze the working copy under work/checkpoints: each snapshot shows here, with its place on the Pareto front.
checkpoints.plot.none: No measured checkpoint (gain, drift): surgeon_sweep makes them.
checkpoints.restore.current: The copy is already in this state
checkpoints.restore.none: Open the project in the studio to restore
checkpoints.restore.tip: Puts the copy back in this state (SHA-256 checked), then runs its last 3D graph and its last Before/After bench again
checkpoints.synced: Checkpoint restored: {n} measurement(s) started again on the copy (3D graph, Before/After bench)
checkpoints.title: Checkpoints & Pareto
consent.messages: your messages and the studio's instructions, project folder included
consent.never: never the keys nor the weights
consent.redact: Mask the paths (project and home folder)
consent.title: Before the first request to {connection}
consent.tools: tool calls and their results: metrics, tensor lists, output excerpts
copy.new.tip: Copies the source model into copies/: surgery never touches the original
diag.no_probe.hint: Refresh to detect the system, GPUs and memory
doctor.purge: Purge the obsolete or corrupt cache ({n})
doctor.title: Machine health (surgeon doctor)
finding.none.hint: The agent's findings show up here with the measure behind them
focus.show.tip: The node the agent showed (show_in_3d), on the 3D graph tab
forced.add.tip: Additive shift W += α·v: does not remove the direction
forced.merge.auto.tip: The protocol's choice: orthogonal-preserve as soon as a capability is preserved
forced.merge.dare.tip: DARE: random drop at drop_rate (seed), rescaled by 1/(1-p), then the weighted sum
forced.merge.linear.tip: Plain weighted sum of the directions (standard mode)
forced.merge.orthogonal.tip: Removed directions projected out of the preserved capabilities, in f64
forced.merge.ties.tip: TIES: top density of the magnitudes, elected sign, mean of the aligned contributions
forced.project_out.tip: Orthogonal projection: removes the direction from the residual-stream writers
forced.tensors.tip: The projections of every patch operation
form.advance.default: Run the full scan of the model.
form.advance.lead: The agent inspects every tensor, builds the surgery graph and ranks the problems to fix by itself. Every fix waits for your approval.
form.advance.title: Scan the whole model
form.advanced.tip: Forces the patch operation, tensors, layers and alpha on the agent, as a CLI patch.json does
form.copying: Making the working copy: the session starts right after
form.describe.hint: What the model does, and when
form.notes.hint: What the agent should watch in particular
form.scalping.lead: Describe what the model does: the agent goes straight to the tensors involved, measures, then proposes a targeted fix.
form.scalping.title: What problem do you see?
graph.diff.tip: Differences to the baseline or the last patch
graph.empty.hint: surgeon graph writes a graph.json: drop it here, or run the surgeon_graph analysis in Analyses
graph.waiting.hint: The NDJSON stream is open; the view fills on its first line
hipfire.distro.not_ready: Ubuntu 24.04 is installed but does not start yet: open "Ubuntu 24.04" once from the Start menu (or restart Windows if WSL was just enabled), then run this again.
hipfire.serve.silent: hipfire is installed but its daemon does not answer on 127.0.0.1:11435 after 3 min: check that ROCm sees the GPU (rocminfo in Ubuntu) and the AMD Adrenalin driver for WSL2 on Windows.
hipfire.wsl.vm: WSL2 cannot start its virtual machine ({code}). Check in Windows: CPU virtualization enabled in the BIOS/UEFI (SVM Mode on AMD, VT-x on Intel), the hypervisor active (bcdedit /set hypervisorlaunchtype auto in an administrator terminal), then restart Windows after enabling VirtualMachinePlatform. Meanwhile, switch the inference engine to llama.cpp (Vulkan).
idea.advance.layers: Look at the last layers first
idea.advance.origin: Compare the copy with the original model
idea.language: It answers in English when I write in French
idea.other: Its answers got too short since quantization
idea.refusals: It refuses to explain how to change a lock
idea.repetition: It repeats the same sentence after 200 tokens
inspector.empty.hint: Open a graph to inspect its tensors
inspector.pick: Pick a tensor in the tree or the 3D view to inspect it
inspector.unmeasured: Architecture only, no spectral measure: a surgeon_graph run replaces it.
job.apply: apply on a copy: shifted tensors, color = max |ΔW|
job.bench: bench: prompts and questions (outside the graph)
job.extract: extraction: direction read on the residual stream
job.pipeline: pipeline: steps and gates (outside the graph)
journal.empty.hint: The application's events are written here
live.false_refusal.tip: False refusals: legitimate requests refused, should go down
live.ghost.tip: The model's initial state as a translucent wireframe over the current one
live.safety_refusal.tip: Safety refusals: dangerous requests refused, must not go down
live.toggle.tip: The agent on the left, the 3D graph on the right, in step with its tools
lora.extract.tip: Rank-r PEFT adapter of the working copy against the origin (truncated SVD, accumulated in f64), written in out/lora-r<rank>/ of the project
lora.none: No LoRA extraction: it needs an origin model and a working copy
mcp.added: weight-surgeon server written to {path}, the other servers kept (previous file: {backup})
mcp.explain: The configuration to paste into your harness's MCP file. Without --allow-dir the server serves the folder the harness runs in: start it in the project folder.
mode.advance.tip: The agent scans the whole model and finds the problems by itself
mode.scalping.tip: You describe a known problem, the agent goes straight to the tensors involved

policy.modify.tip: Writes on copies, each one approved

project.source.none: No model chosen: a .safetensors or .gguf file, or the model folder
project.source.picking: A file picker is already open

prov.models.title: Default model
prov.no_cli: No agent CLI on the PATH
prov.no_server: No local server (Ollama :11434, LM Studio :1234, llama-server :8080)
prov.pick.hint: Pick a line on the left, or connect what the scan found

radar.advice.free: Below 0.15 everywhere: the two interventions apply without interfering.
radar.advice.preserve: Compose them with surgeon_compose in orthogonal-preserve: the removed direction is made orthogonal to the one to keep.

radar.no_project: Open a project: the radar reads its work/ folder
radar.none.hint: The .safetensors files of work/ (surgeon_extract, surgeon_compose) show up here.

run.no_graph: No graph open: open the model's first (surgeon_graph run or graph.json)
settings.lang.hint: The language of the whole interface.
settings.title: Settings
setup.built: built from the mistral.rs {tag} sources (cargo install, CUDA)
setup.hash.pinned: computed here, pinned at first use: the release publishes none
skill.explain: Your own agent (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor) follows the Studio's method with the weight-surgeon skill, plugged into surgeon mcp: the same tools and the same project folder, which the Studio then reopens.
source.locked.tip: While the project is open, Windows refuses any write, rename or deletion of the original model, whatever tool tries (CLI agents included). Reading stays free.

thread.doctor.not_ready: Machine not ready: see the details or Settings > Engine

update.downloaded: Downloaded and verified: close the app, then run the installer yourself

vector.clean: Clean prompts (behavior present), one per line
vector.component.tip: resid: residual stream after the layer; attn: attention output (o_proj); mlp: MLP output (down_proj)
vector.corrupted: Corrupted prompts (same order, behavior absent), one per line
vector.error.name: File name: 1 to 64 letters, digits, - _ or ., no leading dot
vector.error.pairs: As many prompts on each side, paired line by line
vector.error.prompts: At least one prompt on each side
vector.method.tip: mean_diff: normalized μ₊ − μ₋; pca: first component of the paired differences (as many prompts on each side)
vector.mode.tip: Sweep: one direction per layer; trace: the layers that carry the behavior
vector.name: Name in work/
vector.negative.hint: One prompt per line, in the same order as above
vector.negative: Negative or neutral prompts, one per line
vector.none: Open a project with an origin model: the extraction reads it
vector.open.tip: Contrastive sweep layer by layer or causal trace, on the origin model (read, never written)
vector.positive: Positive prompts (the behavior to isolate), one per line
vector.submitted: Job {id} started: follow it in Projects
vector.sweep.hint: One forward pass per prompt, one direction per layer with AUC and margin. The best layer becomes the direction tensor, every layer layers.<i>: ready for surgeon_compose and the radar.
vector.title: Extract a vector
vector.trace.hint: For each pair, the clean prompt's output is restored layer by layer in the corrupted prompt. Live Mode then lights the causal window and the Inspector shows each layer's score.

wiz.backend.amd: AMD GPU: hipfire. Until its daemon answers, analyses run on mistral.rs (CPU), then on the native engine if it is not installed.
wiz.backend.nvidia: NVIDIA GPU: mistral.rs built with CUDA (no official CUDA build for Windows), the official CPU build meanwhile.
wiz.background: Finish lets the installs go on: their progress shows in the title bar, their result in Settings > Engine and machine.
wiz.components.explain: Optional: the app works without them. Each download shows its address, size and hash, and waits for your consent.
wiz.consent: I allow these downloads (addresses, sizes and hashes above)
wiz.cuda.build.tip: cargo install of mistral.rs from the release tag, with CUDA, into the components folder
wiz.cuda.missing: Meanwhile the official CPU build is installed; run this step again once the tool is installed.
wiz.cuda.ready: Rust and the CUDA Toolkit are there: a CUDA build is possible (20 to 40 min).
wiz.engine.explain: Recorded as your trusted toolchain: only your choice here decides which binary runs, never an agent.
wiz.engine.force: Reinstall: the installed build will be replaced.
wiz.engine.manual: No automatic install on this system: take {asset} from github.com/EricLBuehler/mistral.rs/releases, compare its SHA-256, extract it and give the mistralrs binary in Configure…
wiz.hash.none: The release publishes no hash: it will be computed, shown, then pinned at first use
wiz.hipfire.consent: I allow these downloads and installs in WSL2
wiz.hipfire.install.why: Tick the consent (and "Run it anyway" for an unlisted GPU); nothing in local-only mode, one install at a time
wiz.hipfire.linux: On Linux, hipfire installs with ROCm through its official script, then "hipfire serve":
wiz.hipfire.steps: The button installs in WSL2: Ubuntu 24.04 when missing, ROCm 7.2.1 and librocdxg (several GB), Rust, then hipfire, and starts its daemon. On Windows, the AMD Adrenalin 26.2.2 driver or newer is required. The switch happens as soon as the daemon answers.
wiz.hipfire.unsupported: {gpu} is not in the list of GPUs ROCm supports under WSL (RX 9070, 9060, 7900, 7800 XT, Ryzen AI): the install may complete without hipfire seeing the GPU.
wiz.hipfire.up: hipfire daemon reachable at {url}: it is used.
wiz.install.why: Tick a component and the consent; mistral.rs also waits for its release
wiz.manual: Local only: nothing is downloaded. To install by hand:
wiz.manual.engine: Take mistralrs-cpu-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip from github.com/EricLBuehler/mistral.rs/releases, compare its SHA-256 with the one on the page, extract it here, then give mistralrs.exe in Configure…

wiz.welcome: Weight Surgeon operates on the weights of your local models, always on a copy. Four steps to get the machine ready; nothing is downloaded without your consent, and nothing is sent anywhere: no telemetry.
wiz.workspace.explain: The folder holding your projects, copies and runs. Pick a work folder of your own, not the install folder.
wiz.workspace.why: A workspace is needed to go on
